description: Use this when the user asks whether a number came out: '¿salió el 23?', '¿salió el 4512 a la cabeza?', 'controlar quiniela'. Checks a number of 1 to 4 digits (matched by its last digits) against every jurisdiction and turno of a day, a la cabeza or within the first 5, 10 or 20 positions, and lists where it came out. It does not calculate prizes or take bets. When the host shows the result as a widget, the user already sees every number: do not repeat them in a table or list, answer in one or two sentences (what is still pending, or what stands out).

date.description: Draw day in Argentina: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "yesterday". Omit for the latest results.

number.description: The number played, 1 to 4 digits, e.g. "23" or "0451".

name: check_number
title: Controlar un número
